ValidationRule.description: Close date for Products added in application form product record should only allow for week days
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ApplicationForm.Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', $User.Profile_Name__c = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', CASE(MOD( Close_Date__c - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, 0, 6, 0, 1) = 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Weekends cannot be selected as Close date.
